message.content:
The **Navy P-3** usually refers to the **Lockheed P-3 Orion**, a long-range **anti-submarine warfare** and maritime patrol aircraft used by the U.S. Navy.[1][2]

Key facts:
- It was developed for the U.S. Navy and introduced in the **1960s**.[1][3]
- It is a **four-engine turboprop** aircraft based on the Lockheed **L-188 Electra** airliner.[1][3]
- Its mission included **anti-submarine warfare**, **anti-surface warfare**, and maritime surveillance.[2][3]
- The Navy retired P-3s from active-duty patrol squadrons and replaced them with the **P-8A Poseidon**; some P-3 variants still serve in specialized roles.[1][2]
